patch:
diff --git a/src/click/executable_path_metadata.py b/src/click/executable_path_metadata.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2d9c0a4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/executable_path_metadata.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from .types import Path
+
+
+class ExecutablePathMetadata(Path):
+    """A path type that includes its executable check in its metadata."""
+
+    def to_info_dict(self) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+        info_dict = super(Path, self).to_info_dict()
+        info_dict.update(
+            exists=self.exists,
+            file_okay=self.file_okay,
+            dir_okay=self.dir_okay,
+            writable=self.writable,
+            readable=self.readable,
+            allow_dash=self.allow_dash,
+            executable=self.executable,
+        )
+        return info_dict
notes:
